messages.text: Release blocker for AC-ra-54 is unchanged: the store package omits src/features/reports/** (packager DEV_ONLY_DIRS includes 'reports'). Steps: (1) frontend lane renames src/features/reports to a kept name (e.g. src/features/report-center) and updates the importers in src/App.tsx, src/features/result/ResultPage.tsx and src/features/settings/BrandSection.tsx (grep 'features/reports' in src/ and tests/ for any other importer); (2) rerun `node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs` (foreground, about 5 min, long timeout) and expect 8/8 PASS; (3) rerun the remaining phase checks; (4) real 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 update in the Play with data and the green badge, then delete .aioson/system-packages/fitpulse/fitpulse-0.2.0.json.

Can the frontend lane rename src/features/reports (8 files) to a folder name the aioson packager keeps (e.g. report-center) and update its importers? This is still the only blocker for AC-ra-54 at the store-package step. The backend unit did not touch these paths.
